evidence.dominant_driver: Boston Fed President Susan Collins backed last week's rate hike, sees increased risk inflation stays notably above 2%, says labor conditions are stronger, and argues policy can refocus on timely price stability.

market_expectations.expected_value: Further Fed tightening was already an active market scenario after last week's hike; Collins reinforces rather than originates that path.
market_expectations.distribution_notes: No new policy decision; incremental confirmation of a hawkish post-meeting regime.

absorption.reason: By decision time the story was ~130 minutes old. Nasdaq/S&P remained strongly higher and Treasury yields were lower, while gold and the dollar behaved more consistently with the hawkish message.

observations.interpretation: Dollar/gold support the hawkish signal, but falling yields, collapsing oil and strong equities reject an immediate broad risk-off call.

evidence.decision_notes: Residual forecast from actual decision time. Learning profile is empty, so no confidence adjustment is applied.

immediate.rationale: The headline is over two hours old and Nasdaq remained strongly bid; no residual short-horizon bearish confirmation.

next_session.rationale: If Collins' inflation warning reinforces another hike and front-end yields reprice upward, duration-heavy tech is vulnerable next session.

15m.rationale: The headline is over two hours old and Nasdaq remained strongly bid; no residual short-horizon bearish confirmation.

1h.rationale: Hawkish Fed guidance conflicts with falling yields, low VIX and strong AI-led momentum.

4h.rationale: The market has absorbed hawkish rhetoric without a risk-off reversal; chasing downside has weak residual edge.

next_session.rationale: If Collins' inflation warning reinforces another hike and front-end yields reprice upward, duration-heavy tech is vulnerable next session.

predictions.mechanism: More persistent inflation and further tightening raise discount rates for long-duration technology cash flows.
predictions.invalidation: Continued decline in US2Y/US10Y with persistent record-area tech breadth invalidates the next-session downside thesis.
predictions.counter_case: AI momentum, sharply cheaper oil and falling Treasury yields can continue to dominate the hawkish Fed signal.
